title: Simulated repeated authentication failures
summary: Monitoring identified repeated failed sign-ins against an approved lab account. The activity was contained, validated as a controlled exercise, and closed without unauthorized access.

timeline.action: Correlated Windows security events and source host.
Locked the test account and isolated the source client.
Confirmed normal authentication and restored the client.
Closed the exercise and documented lessons learned.

root_cause: Approved authentication-failure simulation using a dedicated lab account.
lessons_learned: Centralized event collection shortened the time required to correlate the account and source workstation.
